memory_update.text: AXTI is the highest-priority underfollowed US-listed candidate for direct InP substrate exposure; later layers must verify InP revenue materiality, 6-inch capability, customer mix, and China/export-permit risk.

VECO is a second-order underfollowed equipment candidate for InP/compound photonics capacity expansion through MOCVD/MBE and optical laser manufacturing tools, but exposure is indirect and must be tested against backlog and segment mix.

node: Indium phosphide substrates and upstream optical materials
summary: Expanded the universe around the InP substrate and optical-materials chokepoint with a two-lane funnel. The cleanest direct US-listed exposure is AXTI, a substrate producer explicitly tied to InP, GaAs and Ge wafers. COHR and LITE are included mainly as reference/customer-context anchors because they operate closer to InP-based optical devices and AI data-center lasers rather than raw substrate supply. VECO is an underfollowed second-order tool candidate because MOCVD/MBE and compound-semiconductor process equipment may benefit if laser and InP epi capacity expands. All candidates require later-layer verification of revenue materiality, 6-inch InP capability, customer concentration, export/geographic risk, and whether AI optical demand is actually constrained at the substrate layer rather than at transceiver assembly, laser packaging, or hyperscaler qualification.
